key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=2%) are diarrhea, abdominal distension, flatulence and dizziness. Diarrhea was the most common AE (16% vs 4% placebo in Trial 1, 26 weeks); severe diarrhea occurred in 2.5% of IBSRELA-treated patients vs 0.2% placebo. Discontinuations for diarrhea occurred in 6.5% vs 0.7% placebo.
